# TDPdf v2.0.2.0

**Fixes: your work survives removing links and rearranging pages, filled-in forms print correctly, and saved files always end in .pdf.**

## Your edits stay

- **Remove Link from PDF** no longer throws away unsaved annotations.
- Rotating, deleting or reordering pages, or removing a link, no longer empties form fields you filled in since your last save.
- Printing a filled-in form without saving it first now prints what you typed.

## Saving

- If you type a name like `report.v2` or `scan.jpg` in Save As, Save Flattened, Extract Pages or Save Searchable PDF, TDPdf adds `.pdf`, and asks before replacing a file that already has that name.
- After a Redact or a text edit on a digitally signed PDF, saving over the original asks first, as any other save of a signed PDF does.

## For administrators

- `/install` and `/uninstall` return specific Windows exit codes: 5 (access denied), 112 (disk full), 1223 (cancelled) and 1618 (another install is running, which Intune retries). Before, every failure returned 1. See `docs/intune-distribution.md`.
- If Windows blocks the text library, moving the pointer over a page no longer shows a crash dialog.

## Accessibility

- Screen readers now announce the sidebar toggle and several close buttons that had no name.
- The keyboard shortcuts overlay shows which button has keyboard focus.
